# 888台灣的公司關係網

Explore Taiwan company registration summaries and direct relationship-index links.

## Agent Skill

- Skill instructions: https://taiwan-company-network.david888.com/skill/
- API contract: https://taiwan-company-network.david888.com/openapi.json
- GET API index: https://taiwan-company-network.david888.com/api/v1/index.json
- Source: https://github.com/tbdavid2019/taiwan-company-network

## WebMCP

When opened in a compatible Chrome WebMCP environment (Chrome 149+ with `#enable-webmcp-testing` or Origin Trial), this site provides both Imperative tools (`document.modelContext.registerTool`) and Declarative HTML form tools:
- `search_taiwan_companies`: Search companies & legal entities by name, stock code, or alias.
- `get_taiwan_company_profile`: Retrieve registered ID, capital, representative, address, and aliases.
- `get_taiwan_company_links`: Retrieve direct upstream and downstream relationship links.
- `open_company_network`: Navigate browser tab directly to the interactive company relationship graph.
- Declarative forms: `search_companies_form`, `quick_company_search`, `switch_relationship_view`.

- WebMCP documentation: https://developer.chrome.com/docs/ai/webmcp?hl=zh-tw
- Tool status: inspect the document root `data-webmcp` and `data-webmcp-tools` attributes.

Relationship links are index data and must not be described as independently verified ownership or investment claims.
